outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar plot of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and the individual data points for each region (gray, red, blue dots) are overlaid on the bars for Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar plot of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for high pH and low pH regions, and individual data points (red and blue dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a plot showing averaged data.
